IRAN CLOSES STRAIT OF HORMUZ INDEFINITELY

Iran’s IRGC navy says the Strait of Hormuz is closed until further notice.

The announcement followed a warning shot fired at a vessel accused of attempting to use an unauthorized route, according to state media.
